page.layout: One page with a large woodcut ornament (a diamond-shaped arabesque of scrolls and foliage) in the middle of the page. Above it, faint show-through of text from the reverse side, which is not transcribed.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. The central element is a woodcut ornament (a diamond-shaped arabesque of scrolls, foliage and lobed panels), not text. The faint lines of text in the upper part of the page are show-through from the reverse side and are not transcribed. A faint small mark at the top left, possibly a number, is too indistinct to read and is not transcribed.
